title: Account
deleteDescription: Permanently delete your account and all of your data.
dialogDescription: This permanently deletes your account and all of your items, collections, tags, files and images. This cannot be undone.
emailLinkNote: We'll email a confirmation link to {email}. Open it while signed in to DevStash to delete the account.
noInbox: Can't receive email at this address? Write to the address in the <link>imprint</link>.
linkSent: Check your inbox at {email}. The link is valid for one hour.
otherAccountTitle: This link is for another account
otherAccountDescription: This browser is signed in with another account than the one the link deletes. Sign out and sign in with that account to continue.
